task: Add Vietnamese (vi) language support to the entire Binayah Properties website

stages.spec:
Add Vietnamese (vi) as a complete, first-class locale across the entire site. This mirrors exactly how ru/zh/ar were added (see git log: commits 97953d44, 0fb4a4bd, 90fe0028, 4bc035b0). The bar: a Vietnamese visitor on /vi/apartments, /vi/buy, /vi/off-plan/abu-dhabi, /vi/golden-visa etc. sees fully Vietnamese content with NO English fallback leaking through, the navbar language switcher offers Tiếng Việt 🇻🇳, and `npx tsc --noEmit` + `npm run build` both pass.

=== Why this will be good ===
Production-ready means PARITY with the four existing locales, not a half-add. Three distinct translation surfaces exist in this codebase and ALL THREE must get vi or the page is half-English: (A) messages/*.json next-intl dictionaries, (B) per-page locale-keyed CONTENT/LABELS object maps, (C) inline `locale === "ru" ? ... : "ar" ? ... : <english>` ternary chains in SEO pages. Surface C is the trap: a missing vi branch does NOT break the build — it silently falls through to the English string. So 'build passes' is necessary but NOT sufficient; the acceptance test is visual Vietnamese on the demo pages. Benchmark: how a top global product (Airbnb, Booking.com) ships a new language — every visible string localized, nothing left in English by accident.

=== EXACT FILE SURFACE (audited iter 1 — this is the complete list) ===

--- 1. Core i18n config ---
- src/i18n/routing.ts (line 8): add "vi" to `locales: ["en","ru","zh","ar"]` → `["en","ru","zh","ar","vi"]`. Also widen the `defaultLocale` cast type union to include "vi".
- src/i18n/request.ts: NO CHANGE — it imports messages/${locale}.json dynamically and validates against routing.locales. Adding vi to routing + creating messages/vi.json is sufficient.
- src/middleware.ts: `LOCALE_PREFIX_REGEX = /^\/(ru|zh|ar)(\/|$)/` → add vi → `/^\/(ru|zh|ar|vi)(\/|$)/`. (createMiddleware(routing) auto-picks up vi from routing; the manual regex must be widened too or vi-prefix detection in the cookie/redirect logic misbehaves.)
- next.config.ts (lines ~47 and ~57): two rewrite rules use `source: "/:locale(ar|ru|zh)/..."`. Add vi to BOTH regex groups → `(ar|ru|zh|vi)`. Without this, /vi/buy-property-in-dubai-marina and /vi/buying-property-in-dubai-as-X do not rewrite and 404.

--- 2. Navbar language switcher ---
- src/components/Navbar.tsx (LANGUAGES_LIST, ~line 19-23): add `{ code: "vi", label: "Tiếng Việt", flag: "🇻🇳" }` after the ar entry. Match the existing object shape exactly.

--- 3. SEO / sitemap / canonical helpers ---
- src/lib/site.ts: (a) `OG_LOCALE` Record (~line 14-15): add `vi: "vi_VN"`. (b) `altLangs()` returned object (~line 22-27): add `vi: "${AE_URL}/vi${path}"`. `canonical()` needs no change — its fallback branch `return ${AE_URL}/${locale}${path}` already handles vi.
- src/app/sitemap.ts: `alternates.languages` object (~line 56-60): add `vi: localeAlt(AE_URL, "vi", path)` alongside ar/zh. (Russian stays cross-domain; vi follows the ar/zh same-domain pattern.)

--- 4. messages/vi.json (THE BIG ONE) ---
- Create messages/vi.json as a COMPLETE Vietnamese translation of EVERY key in messages/en.json. en.json has ~2561 leaf keys across 70+ namespaces (nav, common, home, search, offPlan, rent, buy, valuation, contact, footer, lang, about, signIn, ..., pulseDaily). next-intl throws a BUILD ERROR if any key present in en.json is missing in vi.json. Requirements: (1) translate to natural Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt), not machine word-salad; real estate terms — căn hộ (apartment), biệt thự (villa), nhà phố (townhouse), penthouse stays penthouse, off-plan → 'dự án hình thành trong tương lai' or keep 'off-plan' where it's a proper UI label matching other locales' treatment; (2) preserve ALL interpolation placeholders exactly: `{count}`, `{name}`, `{price}`, ICU plurals, and any HTML/markup tokens — do not translate or reorder placeholder names; (3) keep brand names untranslated (Binayah, Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Aldar, DLD); (4) the `lang` namespace 'Tiếng Việt' self-label and the nav/common high-traffic namespaces matter most for the demo path — get those perfect. Easiest reliable method: load en.json, walk every leaf, translate value-by-value preserving structure and placeholders, write valid JSON. Validate: `node -e "const e=require('./messages/en.json'),v=require('./messages/vi.json');const f=(o,p='')=>Object.entries(o).flatMap(([k,x])=>x&&typeof x==='object'?f(x,p+k+'.'):[p+k]);const ek=new Set(f(e)),vk=new Set(f(v));const missing=[...ek].filter(k=>!vk.has(k));console.log('missing in vi:',missing.length,missing.slice(0,20))"` MUST print `missing in vi: 0`.

--- 5. property-type-pages.ts ---
- src/lib/property-type-pages.ts: locale-keyed map covering all 7 property types. Add a `vi` entry mirroring the existing `ru`/`ar`/`zh` entries — same keys, Vietnamese values. This drives /vi/apartments (THE DEMO PATH), /vi/villas, /vi/townhouses, /vi/penthouses, etc.

--- 6. Per-page locale-keyed CONTENT/LABELS object maps (add a `vi:` block mirroring `ru:`/`ar:`/`zh:` in each) ---
These files have explicit `en:{} ru:{} ar:{} zh:{}` object maps — add a parallel `vi:{}` with the SAME inner keys:
  - src/app/[locale]/golden-visa/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/sell/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/buy-with-crypto/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/rent/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/buy/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/mortgage/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/off-plan/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/off-plan/top-projects/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/buy-property-in/[community]/page.tsx  (LABELS map — task item 7)
  - src/app/[locale]/buying-property-in-dubai-as/[citizen]/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/hudayriyat-island/page.tsx  (LABELS map — task item 9)
  - src/app/[locale]/pulse/calculator/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/pulse/compare/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/pulse/trending/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/services/property-management/page.tsx
GOTCHA: if any of these maps is accessed as `MAP[locale]` without a fallback, a missing vi key = runtime undefined crash. If accessed as `MAP[locale] ?? MAP.en`, missing vi = silent English. Either way, ADD the vi block — do not rely on fallbacks.

--- 7. Inline ternary-chain SEO pages (add a `locale === "vi" ? "..."` branch BEFORE the trailing English fallback in EVERY ternary) ---
These pages build SEO copy (title/description/breadcrumbs/body) with `locale === "ru" ? X : locale === "ar" ? Y : locale === "zh" ? Z : <ENGLISH>`. The trailing English is the fallback, so a missing vi branch compiles fine but renders ENGLISH to Vietnamese users. Add `: locale === "vi" ? "<vietnamese>"` immediately before each final English fallback, for every such ternary in:
  - src/app/[locale]/off-plan/abu-dhabi/page.tsx  (task item 8)
  - src/app/[locale]/off-plan/ras-al-khaimah/page.tsx  (task item 8)
  - src/app/[locale]/off-plan/sharjah/page.tsx  (task item 8)
  - src/app/[locale]/real-estate-marketing/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/pulse/guides/[slug]/page.tsx
  - (the buy/rent/sell/off-plan/golden-visa/buy-with-crypto/mortgage/buying-property-in-dubai-as/top-projects pages from item 6 ALSO contain ternary chains in their generateMetadata — cover those too)
This is the surface most likely to be under-done. Grep your own work before finishing: `grep -rn 'locale === "ar"' src/app --include="*.tsx" | grep -v 'locale === "vi"'` should reveal each ternary chain still lacking a vi branch — work through them.

--- 8. generateStaticParams locale arrays ---
Only 3 files have generateStaticParams with a hardcoded locale array. Add "vi":
  - src/app/[locale]/pulse/guides/[slug]/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/buying-property-in-dubai-as/[citizen]/page.tsx
  - src/app/[locale]/buy-property-in/[community]/page.tsx
If any other generateStaticParams derives locales from routing.locales, it auto-includes vi (no change). Confirm by grepping the array literal in each.

=== Interaction matrix ===
- routing.ts locales × middleware LOCALE_PREFIX_REGEX → both must list vi or cookie/redirect logic and createMiddleware disagree on what's a valid prefix.
- routing.ts locales × next.config rewrite regex (ar|ru|zh) → community + citizen vanity URLs 404 under /vi if regex not widened.
- messages/vi.json × next-intl request.ts → any missing key = hard build failure (this is the safety net that catches surface A gaps).
- localePrefix "as-needed" + defaultLocale en × vi → vi is NEVER the default, so it ALWAYS renders as /vi/... — demo path /vi/apartments is correct. Do NOT add vi to any 'default locale unprefixed' special-case.
- site.ts altLangs/OG_LOCALE × sitemap alternates → keep in sync; both emit hreflang. Mismatch = SEO inconsistency but not a build break.
- NEXT_DEFAULT_LOCALE=ru (binayah.ru VPS) × vi → unaffected; vi is not default anywhere. Do not touch the ru default logic.

=== Edge cases ===
- Empty state: a key untranslated in vi.json → build error (caught by validation script). A missing ternary vi branch → English shows (caught by grep). A missing CONTENT vi block → English-or-crash (caught by visual QA).
- RTL: vi is LTR (like en/ru/zh) — do NOT add vi to the `dir="rtl"` / `isRtl` checks (those are ar-only). Confirm vi pages render dir=ltr.
- Placeholder integrity: any `{count}`/`{name}` mangled in vi.json → runtime ICU error on that string. Preserve exactly.

=== Acceptance criteria (user-visible) ===
1. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes. `npm run build` passes (this proves messages/vi.json has full key parity).
2. Navbar language switcher shows 'Tiếng Việt' with 🇻🇳 and switching to it navigates to the /vi/... prefixed URL via router.replace (the existing @/navigation switcher — no new code path).
3. DEMO PATH: /vi/apartments renders in Vietnamese (hero, headings, body copy — Vietnamese, not English).
4. Spot-check /vi/buy, /vi/off-plan/abu-dhabi, /vi/golden-visa, /vi/mortgage, /vi/hudayriyat-island — all show Vietnamese, no English fallback leaking in main content.
5. `grep -rn 'locale === "ar"' src/app --include="*.tsx" | grep -v 'locale === "vi"'` returns nothing meaningful (every ternary chain has a vi branch).
6. Validation script prints `missing in vi: 0`.
7. No regression: en/ru/ar/zh pages unchanged; ar still RTL.

FILES TO TOUCH (scope boundary — do not modify others): src/i18n/routing.ts, src/middleware.ts, next.config.ts, src/components/Navbar.tsx, src/lib/site.ts, src/app/sitemap.ts, messages/vi.json (NEW), src/lib/property-type-pages.ts, and the page.tsx files enumerated in items 6, 7, 8. Do NOT change src/i18n/request.ts. Do NOT introduce new UI components or restyle anything — this is locale data only.

contextGaps.missing: Translation lives in THREE surfaces, not one: (A) messages/*.json next-intl dicts, (B) per-page locale-keyed CONTENT/LABELS object maps (buy/rent/sell/off-plan/mortgage/golden-visa/buy-with-crypto/buying-as-citizen/hudayriyat/community/pulse-calc/compare/trending/property-management), (C) inline `locale === "ru" ? .. : <english>` ternary chains in ~14 SEO pages (off-plan emirate pages, real-estate-marketing, pulse guides, and the metadata of the surface-B pages). Adding a locale = touching all three. Surface C silently falls back to English when a branch is missing — build passes anyway.

Locale list is hardcoded in SEVEN places that must stay in sync: src/i18n/routing.ts (locales array), src/middleware.ts (LOCALE_PREFIX_REGEX), next.config.ts (two rewrite-rule regexes `(ar|ru|zh)`), src/lib/site.ts (OG_LOCALE + altLangs), src/app/sitemap.ts (alternates.languages), src/components/Navbar.tsx (LANGUAGES_LIST). Only 3 generateStaticParams files hardcode a locale array (pulse/guides/[slug], buying-property-in-dubai-as/[citizen], buy-property-in/[community]).

src/i18n/request.ts is generic (dynamic import of messages/${locale}.json validated against routing.locales) — never needs editing when adding a locale. The next-intl build-time missing-key error is the safety net for messages/*.json parity.

Two distinct CONTENT-map access patterns with DIFFERENT failure modes when a locale block is missing: (a) `CONTENT[locale] ?? CONTENT.en` / `|| CONTENT.en` → silently renders ENGLISH (build passes, English leaks); (b) `if (!(locale in CONTENT)) return notFound()` then `CONTENT[locale as Locale]` → the /<locale>/ page 404s entirely. Pattern (b) is used by sell/page.tsx, buy-with-crypto/page.tsx, services/property-management/page.tsx — for these, a missing vi block is a hard 404, NOT an English fallback. Always add the vi block; never rely on either fallback.

GOTCHA: hudayriyat-island/page.tsx hardcodes its own `type Locale = "en"|"ru"|"ar"|"zh"` at top of file (NOT derived from routing.locales). Adding a locale to a page like this requires widening that local Locale union too, plus any per-locale helper (e.g. TABLE_ROWS_VI + a branch in getTableRows()), or tsc fails / English shows. Most per-page maps instead use `type Locale = keyof typeof CONTENT` which auto-includes the new locale once the CONTENT block is added.

OG_LOCALE inline ternaries `locale === "ar" ? "ar_AE" : ... : "en_AE"` appear in property/[slug], project/[slug], news/[slug], hudayriyat — these duplicate the OG_LOCALE map in site.ts. A new locale needs a branch here too (e.g. vi → vi_VN) or its OG tags fall back to en_AE (SEO inconsistency, not a build break). site.ts OG_LOCALE map is the canonical source but these pages don't import it.
